description: This file defines API client interfaces for content, metadata, assets, and likes, along with stubbed default implementations for each to simulate server responses.

classes.name: ApaMetadataClient
classes.description: Interface for fetching metadata related to content.

classes.name: ApaAssetsClient
classes.description: Interface for fetching asset information related to content.

classes.name: DefaultStubClients
classes.description: Object providing stubbed implementations of the above interfaces for testing or default use.

methods.name: fetchContent
methods.description: Fetches content data based on content ID.

methods.name: fetchMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata for a given content ID.

methods.name: fetchAssets
methods.description: Retrieves assets associated with a content ID.

methods.name: postLike
methods.description: Posts a like or rating for a content item.
